surfaces.purpose: Keep the archive from collapsing into mere harm-management by protecting access to play, beauty, learning, craft, and shared celebration above the floor.
Keep price, payment, and willingness to pay from being mistaken for sufficient moral permission in domains where standing, care, culture, or bodily integrity are at stake.
Keep bold synthesis visible without silently hardening it into law.
Keep protection and service from hardening into guardianship by requiring meaningful, reviewable opportunities for affected people to shape shared rule.
Translate value into governance without scalar capture.
Keep childhood from being treated as mere adult preparation by making present goods, play, caregiver stability, and evolving-capacity voice visible in design and policy.

Keep later life, frailty, palliative care, social connection, and bereavement visible so longevity is not confused with ageist abandonment, coercive prolongation, or social death before biological death.
Keep humiliation, stigma, civic invisibility, and caste-like ranking visible as direct degradations rather than hiding them behind income, rights, or average welfare.
Keep floors, priority to the worse-off, and anti-oligarchic safeguards visible whenever protected goods are allocated under scarcity.
Keep shelter, tenure, neighborhood continuity, and freedom from forced uprooting visible so indoor status is not confused with the ability to actually dwell.
Keep bodily integrity, valid consent, and reproductive agency visible so care, medicine, safety, or family order do not quietly become excuses for bodily commandeering.
Keep close personal bonds visible as non-substitutable goods while protecting people against coercive kinship, forced intimacy, chosen-kin erasure, and exit penalties.
Sort candidate goods into kernels, scaffolding, indicators, local aims, or quarantine before the ontology bloats.
Keep decent livelihood, work quality, and the refusal of degrading labor visible so employment counts do not hide servility, job lock, or contribution stigma.
Keep arbitrary exile, status precarity, family separation, blocked return, and camp limbo visible so shelter or service delivery do not masquerade as full belonging.
Separate direct welfare subjects from life-supporting systems so scope can widen without ontology blur.
Keep stated desire morally important without letting resignation or manipulation masquerade as the good.
Protect high-weight floors before optimizing above them.
Keep agency, intimacy, dissent, and selective self-disclosure from being dissolved by permanent surveillance, mandatory exposure, or one-way legibility to power.
Keep accountability distinct from humiliation and permanent civic exile by requiring victim protection, reparative pathways, and reviewable return after breach.
Preserve replay paths while keeping notes compact.
Keep growth legible across personal, social, institutional, and temporal layers.
Keep usable time, rest, schedule predictability, and freedom from permanent availability visible so rights and flourishing do not become merely nominal.
Handle unavoidable kernel collisions without pretending all losses are compensable.
Keep serious uncertainty from licensing either irreversible harm or permanent status-quo paralysis.
Keep normate design, petition-based access, and segregated service visible so equal standing is not confused with nominal availability.
